answer: Weight equals earned credentials, not wallets — influence grows like a meadow, one blade per epoch. Each epoch, a graded micro-task before a VRF-sampled jury of three peers mints a non-transferable, history-bound credential. Attack cost: weight cannot be bought — 500 Sybils must pay honest-work costs for many epochs, and jurors appear only after submission, so bribes lack targets. One caught collusion slashes the stack beneath, like basalt strata never reordered. In this garden, power scales with verifiable work per head — Sybil profit turns negative.
